title: Rabbi Yitzchak bar Bar Chana
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yoma 77b quotes him saying, “I saw Zeiri go to visit his student Rav Chiya bar Ashi.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Yitzchak bar Rav Chana. In Bava Kamma 52a he explains that it became wormy within. Hyman says Seder HaDorot conflated this Amora with Rav Yitzchak, son of Rabbah bar bar Chana, whereas they were two sages who lived at different times.

notes.text: The first version in Yoma 77b has Zeiri visiting his student Chiya bar Ashi, as Hyman quotes. Rav Ashi then gives an alternative, Chiya visiting his teacher Zeiri. These are distinct versions, not a reason to silently reverse the notice’s first account. The two-Yitzchak distinction is Hyman’s claim.
